Email them or delete them?

Every email marketer with a growing list hits this wall. Both options have real consequences which also can result in indecisiveness.

Option 1 – Email them

Send to your full list and risk bounces, complaints, and reputation damage that affects deliverability for everyone on your list. Not just the cold segment.

Option 2 – Delete them

Remove them permanently and lose the acquisition cost you already spent. Some of those subscribers would have come back with the right approach at the right pace.

What if there was a third option?

How It Works

Three steps. Connect your ESP, let the system classify your list, and re-engage your cold subscribers at a pace that protects your domain.

01

See who's cold and who's costing you

Connect your ESP. The system reads your engagement data and identifies which subscribers have gone dormant and how long they have been inactive.

List Clarity

02

Separate the recoverable from the risky

Subscribers are classified by inactivity depth and risk level. The system identifies who is worth re-engaging and who could damage your domain if you mail them.

Smart Classification

03

Re-engage safely on autopilot

Emails send one at a time with throttled pacing. The safety system watches bounce rates and complaint rates in real time. If anything looks wrong, sending pauses automatically.

Protected Recovery

Every action is permanently logged. You see exactly what the system does and why.

Common Questions

Everything you need to know about safely recovering your cold list.

You connect your ESP account through our encrypted integration. We currently support Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, and Kit, with Mailchimp and HubSpot coming soon. Your data stays in your ESP. We read engagement data and trigger sends through your existing platform.

That is the entire reason this platform exists. The safety system monitors bounce rates, complaint rates, and domain health in real time. If any metric approaches a risk threshold, sending pauses automatically. You can also set your own thresholds and pause or stop campaigns manually at any time.

They stay in your ESP. ReEngage Pro classifies them but never deletes subscriber data. You decide what to do with subscribers who do not respond to re-engagement. We give you the information to make that call.

Yes. The AI generates personalized email content based on subscriber history and behavior patterns, but you review and approve everything before it sends. You can also write your own copy and use the platform purely for its throttle engine and safety monitoring.

Re-engagement is not instant. The system sends slowly and carefully on purpose. Most campaigns run over 2-4 weeks depending on list size. You will see real-time progress in the dashboard as subscribers respond.

All ESP connections use AES-256 encryption. Your subscriber data stays in your ESP. We read it through the API to classify and trigger sends, but we do not store your full subscriber list on our servers. We are GDPR compliant with full data export and deletion capabilities.
